In Chin. and Jpn. Incompatibility. The manufacturers recommend that a solution containing nicardipine hydrochloride 100 micrograms/mL is used for intravenous infusion. Suitable diluents are solutions of glucose or sodium chloride. Sodium bicarbonate and lactated Ringer’s are incompatible with nicardipine infusion. Nicardipine hydrochloride (1 mg/mL in glucose 5%) has also been reported1 to be visually incompatible with furosemide, heparin, and thio- pental. 1. Chiu MF, Schwartz ML.
